request.deadline: 12 months; pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027
deliverables: WP 1: Community-Facing Technical Coordination funded at 256,000 ADA for technical expert event attendance and commissioned technical reports.
WP 2: Protocol Governance and Evolution funded at 832,000 ADA for the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.
WP 3: Technical Review funded at 105,000 ADA for a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027.
request.recipient: Intersect / Intersect Technical Steering Committee support via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee support for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support TSC activities for 12 months.
The proposal says WP 1 funds attendance of technical experts at major ecosystem events and commissioning of technical reports.
The proposal says WP 2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.

The proposal says WP 3 funds a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
The proposal states that technical workshops, the Security Council, and the Bug Bounty Programme are funded separately through the main Intersect budget and are excluded from this request.
The proposal commits that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.

The proposal states the requested amount did not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with named reserve and project-specific addresses, specified multi-party authorization thresholds, external oversight entities, audits, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, split across three work packages, with stated accounting, smart-contract custody, external assurance, and dependencies on broader Intersect budget approval.
